description: This file defines a final class 'ControlFlowFactory' that provides a factory method for creating message objects with sender information in an Akka-based control flow context. It includes a static method 'messageWithSender' that takes a generic message and an ActorRef sender, returning a bundled message with sender.

classes.name: ControlFlowFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating message-with-sender objects in the control flow context.

methods.name: messageWithSender
methods.description: Creates a bundled message object that pairs a message of type T with a sender ActorRef.
